name: paper-minis
description: Generate printable paper miniatures from a roster of monsters or characters.
author: Local project

commands.name: build-minis
commands.description: Build a printable mini sheet from a roster file or pasted list.

instructions: Use the existing Python pipeline in ./paper-minis/scripts rather than creating a new renderer.
For installation and usage, prefer the repo's README and skill docs over ad hoc assumptions.
When the user asks for paper minis, parse the roster, run build_minis.py, and then report where the output was written.
